summary: Hold release/export: 7 critical or high decision-provenance blocker(s) need remediation before reviewer decisions are durable and public-safe.

findings.message: T-private-note contains a private reviewer note without export redaction.
findings.evidence: Repository exports must not leak private reviewer notes, blind-review details, or hidden institutional comments.
findings.remediation: Redact private notes and preserve only a public-safe reason code in the exported decision record.

findings.message: T-notebook-role has no durable resolution rationale.
findings.evidence: A resolved scientific review thread needs enough rationale for future auditors and citation readers.
findings.remediation: Record the accepted change, scientific reasoning, or deferral basis in the resolution rationale.

findings.message: T-metadata-missing-export is resolved but not marked for export.
findings.evidence: Resolved scientific review decisions should be carried into release/export evidence instead of disappearing after merge.
findings.remediation: Set exported=true and include the record in the reviewDecisionPacket manifest entry.

findings.message: The export manifest does not link the review-decision provenance packet.
findings.evidence: Resolved scientific review decisions must be carried with the release/export evidence.
findings.remediation: Add a reviewDecisionPacket entry with packet hash, record count, and covered components.

findings.message: T-notebook-role uses reviewer role viewer for notebook.
findings.evidence: Allowed reviewer roles for notebook: reproducibility-reviewer, methods-reviewer.
findings.remediation: Add an eligible reviewer decision or document an escalation override in the decision record.

findings.message: T-notebook-role is missing file path or commit anchoring.
findings.evidence: Decision records cannot prove which repository content was reviewed without path and commit anchors.
findings.remediation: Attach anchor.path and anchor.commit for the reviewed file or notebook output.

findings.message: T-code-open is not resolved but is present in the release decision packet.
findings.evidence: This guard archives resolved decision provenance; open discussions should be routed back to merge review.
findings.remediation: Resolve the discussion with a rationale or remove it from the release decision packet until review is complete.

findings.message: T-code-open has no linked evidence references.
findings.evidence: Decision records should link tests, rendered outputs, reviewer screenshots, or manifest entries.
findings.remediation: Attach evidenceRefs for tests, outputs, exported artifacts, or reviewer attachments.

findings.message: T-notebook-role has no linked evidence references.
findings.evidence: Decision records should link tests, rendered outputs, reviewer screenshots, or manifest entries.
findings.remediation: Attach evidenceRefs for tests, outputs, exported artifacts, or reviewer attachments.
